access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (dress research for the 1812 scene). A small white cotton dress with puffed short sleeves, high waist and embroidered hem; the museum page records that it was 'worn by the brother of Harriet Beecher Stowe', most likely Henry Ward Beecher (born 1813), so a dress worn by an infant boy.
note: Entered for the 1812 children's dress (T-3465; docs/RESEARCH/people-1812-dress/children.md) from the dress research of docs/RESEARCH/people-1812-3461/dress.json; not a Chicago or Fort Dearborn record.
